methodology.revenue_estimate: Current-year reported quarterly revenue annualized by reported months; fallback to latest annual revenue when YTD data unavailable.
methodology.dividend_estimate: Estimated revenue × scenario NPM × scenario DPR ÷ shares outstanding; estimated yield = DPS ÷ latest price.
methodology.caveat: Exploratory estimate only. Fiscal periods, special dividends, share changes, corporate actions and incomplete Yahoo data may distort results. Validate against official filings. BBNI share count corrected in current snapshot to issued shares scale; rerun the monthly workflow to regenerate all tickers using market-cap-implied share-count validation.
